title: Warm Pork Knuckle Wrap
description: A hearty German-inspired wrap filled with warm pork knuckle and topped with a tangy slaw.
instructions: 2. Season the pork knuckle with salt, pepper, and caraway seeds (if using).
3. Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe pan over medium-high heat. Sear the pork knuckle until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
4. Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and roast the pork knuckle for 20-25 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
5. Meanwhile, cook the sliced onion and carrots in a pan over medium heat until tender, about 5-7 minutes.
6. Warm the wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
7. Assemble the wrap by placing the sliced pork knuckle, sauerkraut, and cooked onion and carrots inside the warm wrap.
8. Drizzle with brown mustard and serve immediately.
